name: fixflow
description: FixFlow — home-service management web application for a single small business (portfolio project)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names shared,server,web --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && eslint .
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run test:integration -w @fixflow/server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run test:e2e -w @fixflow/e2e
